verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Deploy Previews, per-PR preview URLs, and a shareable preview environment where collaborators can 'preview content updates'. None of it shows a way for teammates to leave comments directly on preview or production deploys. Viewing and reviewing previews is an adjacent capability, not in-context commenting, and nothing addresses commenting on production at all.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let teammates and collaborators comment directly on preview and production environments
